limitations: Only targets with complete successful jobs, checkout-log provenance, and all three matching evidence scopes are marked passed.
Exact API equivalence remains false; accepted differences are retained by category, reason, and name.
Native corpus, API comparison, and all-record checks overlap and must not be added as counts of unique assertions.

AArch64 va_list storage fields are checked by independent C record probes, while corresponding private bindgen fields are excluded from shared-field comparison; optimized native FFI tests are separate.
Counts are per project and may include the same helper record in more than one project.
These pinned headers and selected FFI calls do not establish complete C conformance or production readiness.

separate_unit_and_tooling_run.scope: Workspace tests (including optimized C va_list FFI) on four native hosts, lint, and Rust 1.96 compatibility. This is separate from the corpus workflow.

separate_fuzz_smoke_run.scope: CI fuzz smoke workflow using its default sanitizer configuration; separate from the local semantic run with LeakSanitizer disabled.
